outcomes.name: The benefits approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The benefits approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Planning & Risk to identify what needs to change in the benefits approach before scaling.
Refine the benefits approach to Planning & Risk based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined benefits approach covering Planning & Risk ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined benefits approach for Planning & Risk is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the benefits approach for Planning & Risk remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the benefits approach affected Process & Sustainment.
Adapt the benefits approach relating to Process & Sustainment for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the benefits approach covering Process & Sustainment to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Process & Sustainment among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the benefits approach for Process & Sustainment.
